reponse: The old approach was to set FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local and restart vite [1], but that no longer works: the flag is now renamed dashboards_v2 and flags are served by the API, so FEATURE_FLAGS in .env.local is ignored [2]. Locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page [3]; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3].
